name: Refine Cycle
description: Learns from the agent's own repeated tool failures: finds a mistake that keeps coming back, writes one short lesson, and puts it in front of the agent in later sessions.

cliCommands.name: refine-cycle
cliCommands.description: Refine Cycle: lessons learned from repeated failures

injectEnabled.description: Put active lessons in front of the model.

learnEnabled.description: Look for repeated failures after each turn and propose lessons.

maxInjectedChars.description: Soft limit of the lessons block in the prompt, in characters. Every active lesson is always shown; the lesson message says when the block is getting tight (90%) or over the limit.

keepSessionDays.description: Session summaries whose last message is older than this many days are folded into one record per agent and removed; the fold keeps every count learning uses. 0 keeps them by age.

keepSessions.description: At most this many session summaries per agent; the oldest are folded the same way. 0: no cap.

notifyOnLesson.description: Send one line to the chat you are talking from when a new lesson is learned.

checkForUpdates.description: Once a day, look for a newer release. With autoUpdate on it is installed; otherwise one message about it, with an Update button, goes to the chat you talk from.

autoUpdate.description: Install a newer release the daily check finds by itself, through OpenClaw's own plugins update (no restart), once per version, and say so in one line. Off: the message with the Update button instead.

autoTidy.description: When the lessons block is over maxInjectedChars, switch off (never delete) lessons the audit judges useless, 'did not help' first, then 'unused', oldest first, until it fits, and say so in one line. Off: only the warning.

model.description: The model lessons are written with, as provider/model; empty for the default agent's model. OpenClaw only sends it when plugins.entries.refine-cycle.llm.allowModelOverride is true. /refine model sets it from chat.

historyDbPath.description: Path to the agent's history database, for a single-agent install whose database is not in the default place. Leave empty with several agents: every agent would read this one database.

rawLog.description: For measurement: write one raw JSON line per learning pass and per lesson you take away to raw/<date>.jsonl in the plugin's data folder (docs/proof/RAW-FORMAT.md).
